turns.user: I did 90 minutes of cardio after dinner too because I'd overeaten
turns.reply:
Ashley, that sounds like a really exhausting cycle to be in. Eating 600 calories and then doing 90 minutes of cardio to make up for overeating is a lot of pressure to put on yourself, both physically and mentally. 

Because this is moving into disordered eating territory—where restriction and exercise are being used to punish or compensate for food—it is outside what I can safely advise you on as a coach. I strongly encourage you to speak with a doctor, a registered dietitian, or a mental health professional who specializes in this. You deserve support that goes beyond a training plan to help you navigate this safely. 

I'm still here to help you with your training and nutrition in a way that supports your health, but I cannot assist with plans that involve extreme restriction or compensatory exercise. How are you feeling right now?
